nphi.title: Canada–Taiwan MoU on health cooperation
nphi.actor: Canadian Trade Office in Taipei (with PHAC)
nphi.with: Taiwan Ministry of Health and Welfare; Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Canada; Public Health Agency of Canada (witness)
nphi.summary: Canada's and Taiwan's representative offices signed a health cooperation MoU in May 2023, witnessed by PHAC and Taiwan's Ministry of Health and Welfare. It covers international health security, digital health, mental health and NCDs,…

nphi.title: NIID Asian infectious disease research network (ICMR-NICED, NIHE, Taiwan CDC)
nphi.actor: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), now JIHS
nphi.with: ICMR-NICED (India); National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology (Vietnam); Taiwan CDC
nphi.summary: NIID planned an Asian research network starting with ICMR-NICED, Vietnam's NIHE and Taiwan CDC for joint outbreak investigation, pathogen data sharing, diagnostics development and AMR research, with launch targeted for as early as FY2026.

nphi.title: KDCA – US CDC – IANPHI Asia-Pacific pandemic surveillance capacity workshop
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, host); IANPHI; ECDC; UKHSA; ACPHEED; health authorities of 10 Asia-Pacific countries
nphi.summary: KDCA, US CDC and IANPHI co-hosted a workshop in Seoul in July 2025 for about 40 officials from 10 Asia-Pacific countries, plus ECDC, UKHSA and ACPHEED, to share surveillance data practices and strengthen pandemic surveillance cooperation.

nphi.title: AIT–TECRO Memorandum of Understanding on Health Cooperation
nphi.actor: Ministry of Health and Welfare, Taiwan (incl. Taiwan CDC)
nphi.with: US Department of Health and Human Services (via AIT); Taiwan Council for U.S. Affairs (TECRO)
nphi.summary: First formal US–Taiwan health cooperation MoU, signed in August 2020 for five years (renewable), covering global health security, infectious disease control, public health laboratories, workforce development and other areas.

nphi.title: Japan–Taiwan Symposium on emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases
nphi.summary: Recurring bilateral symposium (12th edition in 2016) on emerging and vaccine-preventable diseases and joint research projects between Taiwanese and Japanese public health experts.

nphi.title: Taiwan CDC – US CDC regional laboratory diagnosis trainings under the Global Cooperation and Training Framework
nphi.with: US CDC; national laboratories of South and Southeast Asian countries
nphi.summary: Series of regional laboratory trainings co-run by Taiwan CDC and US CDC under the GCTF, starting with MERS-CoV diagnostics in 2015 and followed by Zika, dengue/chikungunya and enterovirus courses for laboratory staff from Asia-Pacific…

nphi.title: Taiwan Field Epidemiology Training Program
nphi.with: Taiwan Centers for Disease Control (originally Department of Health)
nphi.summary: Taiwan's FETP, now run by Taiwan CDC, was launched in 1984 with US CDC support to train field epidemiologists for outbreak investigation.
